metadata.description: Use when writing, reviewing, or debugging Ansible playbooks, roles, collections, inventory, Vault, Molecule, execution environments, or CI — diagnoses failure mode (idempotency drift, blast radius, secret exposure, variable precedence, inventory correctness, handler ordering, check-mode blind spots, collection supply chain, execution environment) with two-axis risk framing.

plugins.name: ansible-skill
plugins.description: Diagnose-first Ansible and ansible-core guidance for Claude Code, with a two-axis Response Contract (idempotency and blast-radius) and a 9-category routing table.
